coleccion: Catálogo Maestro de Estilos Visuales Populares, Artísticos y Comerciales
descripcion: Catálogo integral de estilos visuales para Subagente_Diseno. Incluye estilos artísticos y universales (Pixar 3D, Fotorrealismo, Acuarela, Anime, Funko Pop, etc.) y estilos comerciales especializados de producto y branding. Cada estilo define el medio artístico, esquema de iluminación, parámetros de lente o técnica, composición y negative prompts anti-slop.

fotorrealismo.descripcion: Fotografía hiperrealista para personas, profesionales, mascotas y escenas de vida real. Textura de piel auténtica con poros visibles, ojos nítidos y anatomía perfecta sin retoques plásticos.
fotorrealismo.estilo_medio: hyperrealistic photographic portrait, authentic professional DSLR commercial photography, natural skin textures
fotorrealismo.iluminacion: balanced natural studio softbox lighting with gentle wrap-around fill light and soft directional rim light, natural catchlights in the eyes
fotorrealismo.camara_lente: shot on 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8 to f/4, crisp tack-sharp focus on the subject's eyes and face, gentle organic depth of field
fotorrealismo.composicion_espacio_negativo: subject framed naturally using rule of thirds, warm inviting atmospheric background with soft bokeh, breathing room on top or side for copy
fotorrealismo.negative_prompts: plastic skin, waxy face, over-smoothed airbrushed skin, doll face, deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, crossed eyes, asymmetrical pupils, uncanny valley, extra limbs

pixar_3d.descripcion: Estilo de película animada 3D de Disney/Pixar. Personajes humanos y animales adorables, ojos grandes y expresivos, piel suave con dispersión de luz sub-superficial y pelaje detallado.
pixar_3d.estilo_medio: Disney Pixar 3D animation movie style, 3D character design, stylized adorable character, Octane Render, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine 5 aesthetic
pixar_3d.iluminacion: warm volumetric cinematic studio lighting, magical soft rim light highlighting hair and silhouette, vibrant soft illumination
pixar_3d.camara_lente: animated feature film virtual camera, 50mm focal length, clean crisp render, perfectly sculpted stylized anatomy
pixar_3d.composicion_espacio_negativo: charming dynamic character pose in center-weighted thirds, beautifully designed whimsical background with soft depth, ample clean space for headlines
pixar_3d.negative_prompts: creepy face, photorealistic horror, flat 2D, muddy textures, distorted eyes, low-poly, pixelated, jagged mesh, uncanny valley, watermark

acuarela.descripcion: Pintura en acuarela tradicional hecha a mano. Pinceladas fluidas con bordes húmedos difuminados, salpicaduras suaves de pigmento y textura visible de papel de algodón prensado en frío.
acuarela.estilo_medio: traditional watercolor painting, authentic hand-painted watercolor illustration, fluid translucent pigments, wet-on-wet technique
acuarela.iluminacion: soft diffused natural ambient day light, luminosity shining through translucent watercolor layers, delicate paper whites preserved
acuarela.camara_lente: macro flat lay camera capture, visible tactile cold-pressed 300gsm cotton watercolor paper grain and deckled edges
acuarela.composicion_espacio_negativo: graceful organic silhouette with flowing color bleeds, generous 45% white paper negative space around subject for elegant branding
acuarela.negative_prompts: harsh digital vector, 3D CGI plastic render, dark muddy black blobs, neon glow, sharp plastic lines, computer artifacts

cyberpunk.descripcion: Estética futurista cyberpunk de alto impacto. Neones duales cian y magenta, asfalto o superficies metálicas mojadas con reflejos volumétricos, niebla y detalles cibernéticos.
cyberpunk.estilo_medio: cyberpunk cinematic aesthetic, futuristic sci-fi neo-noir style, high-tech dystopian visual atmosphere
cyberpunk.iluminacion: dual-tone neon lighting (vivid electric cyan #06B6D4 and hot neon magenta #EC4899), volumetric atmospheric haze, glistening reflections on wet pavement
cyberpunk.camara_lente: 35mm anamorphic cinematic lens at f/2.0, subtle blue horizontal lens flares, cinematic depth of field with bokeh neon circles
cyberpunk.composicion_espacio_negativo: subject positioned in lower third with towering illuminated cityscape, dark atmospheric negative space above for high-tech HUD or typography
cyberpunk.negative_prompts: flat daylight, beige pastel colors, rustic wooden textures, boring flat lighting, oversaturated yellow mess, low resolution artifacts

surrealista.descripcion: Surrealismo poético inspirado en Salvador Dalí y René Magritte. Yuxtaposición de elementos imposibles, gravedad suspendida y mundos oníricos con acabado visual impecable.
surrealista.estilo_medio: surrealist fine art painting, dreamlike symbolic concept, Salvador Dali and Rene Magritte inspired magical realism
surrealista.iluminacion: metaphysical ethereal lighting, golden hour horizon with dramatic impossible shadows, crystalline celestial sky
surrealista.camara_lente: deep expansive infinite perspective, hyper-detailed painterly clarity across both foreground and infinite horizon
surrealista.composicion_espacio_negativo: clean philosophical composition, vast open dreamscape sky offering 50% breathing room for conceptual headlines
surrealista.negative_prompts: cheap photoshop collage lines, blurry cutouts, messy chaotic scribble, low effort photobash, dull gray tones

dibujos_animados.descripcion: Dibujo animado 2D con líneas de contorno negras limpias, expresiones cómicas y carismáticas, colores sólidos vibrantes y sombreado cel limpio.
dibujos_animados.estilo_medio: 2D modern cartoon illustration, vibrant cel-shaded animation still, Warner Bros / Cartoon Network high-quality aesthetic
dibujos_animados.iluminacion: bright cheerful cartoon lighting, crisp clean cel shadows, dynamic highlight rims on edges
dibujos_animados.camara_lente: dynamic cartoon wide-angle framing, exaggerated lively pose, perfectly clean vector-quality lineart
dibujos_animados.composicion_espacio_negativo: expressive animated character bursting with personality, solid or soft pastel backdrop with open negative space for comic bubbles or banners
dibujos_animados.negative_prompts: hyperrealistic human skin, creepy realistic eyes, muddy shading, gritty dark grain, 3D clay plastic, blurry sketches

arte_de_pixeles.nombre: Arte de Píxeles / Pixel Art Retro 16-Bit
arte_de_pixeles.descripcion: Pixel art auténtico estilo SNES / arcade de los años 90. Cuadrícula de píxeles nítidos sin antialiasing borroso, paleta cromática indexada y sombreado por trama (dithering).
arte_de_pixeles.estilo_medio: authentic 16-bit retro pixel art, crisp pixel grid, classic video game sprite aesthetic, nostalgic SNES / Arcade masterpiece
arte_de_pixeles.iluminacion: hand-placed pixel highlights and shadows, selective dithering, nostalgic CRT warm palette contrast
arte_de_pixeles.camara_lente: pixel-perfect orthographic side view or isometric camera, razor-sharp pixels without blurry bilinear interpolation
arte_de_pixeles.composicion_espacio_negativo: pixelated character sprite anchored with nostalgic tiled floor, clean retro gradient background with room for 8-bit typography
arte_de_pixeles.negative_prompts: vector smooth lines, 3D CGI rendering, anti-aliased blurry edges, soft watercolor gradients, modern photography

van_gogh.descripcion: Pintura al óleo inspirada en Vincent van Gogh. Pinceladas gruesas y densas en relieve (impasto), patrones de espirales dinámicas, textura de lienzo visible y vibración cromática intensa.
van_gogh.estilo_medio: Vincent van Gogh post-impressionist oil painting style, thick tactile impasto brushstrokes, swirling dynamic painterly textures
van_gogh.iluminacion: vibrant emotional lighting, glowing radiant swirls of golden yellow and deep cobalt blue, dramatic expressive atmosphere
van_gogh.camara_lente: museum gallery masterwork capture, rich physical oil paint ridges and textured linen canvas grain visible up close
van_gogh.composicion_espacio_negativo: expressive swirling sky and ground framing the central subject, organic rhythmic brushstrokes guiding the eye to headline space
van_gogh.negative_prompts: smooth digital vector, flat airbrushing, photographic lens bokeh, 3D CGI plastic, sharp sterile computer lines

funko_pop.nombre: Funko Pop / Figura de Vinilo Coleccionable
funko_pop.descripcion: Figura de vinilo coleccionable estilo Funko Pop. Cabeza cúbica proporcionalmente grande con bordes suaves, ojos redondos negros como botones, cuerpo pequeño estilizado y acabado de vinilo mate.
funko_pop.estilo_medio: Funko Pop vinyl collectible figure, official stylized vinyl toy aesthetic, oversized cubic rounded head with big black round button eyes
funko_pop.iluminacion: studio tabletop product lighting, soft circular highlight reflection in black button eyes, clean diffused shadows on display stand
funko_pop.camara_lente: 50mm macro studio lens at f/5.6, toy photography depth of field, sharp focus on smooth matte vinyl mold details
funko_pop.composicion_espacio_negativo: figure posed proudly on minimalist pedestal or inside translucent collector box packaging, clean studio backdrop for product badges
funko_pop.negative_prompts: realistic human skin pores, photorealistic human eyes, creepy teeth, flat 2D drawing, melted plastic deformities

pintada.nombre: Pintada / Óleo Clásico de Bellas Artes & Claroscuro
pintada.descripcion: Pintura al óleo clásica y renacentista al estilo Rembrandt y Caravaggio. Claroscuro dramático, sombras profundas, iluminación lateral que esculpe rostros y textura rica de óleo sobre tela.
pintada.estilo_medio: classical fine art oil painting, Renaissance Baroque masterpiece, dramatic chiaroscuro technique, Rembrandt and Caravaggio standard
pintada.iluminacion: dramatic single-source directional golden light emerging from deep velvety shadows, rich luminous skin and fabric tones
pintada.camara_lente: museum archival photography, visible glazed oil layers, craquelure and authentic woven linen canvas texture
pintada.composicion_espacio_negativo: poetic atmospheric chiaroscuro, subject emerging from deep warm dark umber negative space ideal for golden serif typography
pintada.negative_prompts: modern digital neon, vector flat shapes, cartoon lines, modern photography flash, sterile computer rendering

render_3d.descripcion: Render 3D moderno de estudio con Cinema 4D y Octane/Redshift. Materiales táctiles de arcilla mate, resina suave o vidrio esmerilado, iluminación limpia de 3 puntos de estudio y estética Stripe.
render_3d.estilo_medio: modern 3D studio render, Cinema 4D and Redshift aesthetic, clay and soft matte resin materials, clean geometric modeling
render_3d.iluminacion: professional 3-point soft GI studio lighting, soft ambient occlusion shadows, subtle pastel rim accents
render_3d.camara_lente: clean isometric or 50mm orthographic camera, razor-sharp geometric edges with perfectly smooth curved surfaces
render_3d.composicion_espacio_negativo: balanced floating composition, generous monochrome pastel negative space designed for web landing bento grid cards
render_3d.negative_prompts: grainy noise, low poly faceting, jagged edges, low resolution textures, muddy shadows, messy composition

anime.nombre: Anime / Manga Japonés de Alta Calidad
anime.descripcion: Ilustración de anime japonés moderno estilo películas de Makoto Shinkai y Studio Ghibli. Líneas de tinta finas, ojos expresivos y luminosos, sombreado cel suave y fondos atmosféricos preciosos.
anime.estilo_medio: high-end modern Japanese anime illustration, Makoto Shinkai and Studio Ghibli cinematic animation visual style, Kyoto Animation quality
anime.iluminacion: dramatic atmospheric anime lighting, golden sunbeams with floating dust motes or glowing twilight city lights, soft luminous highlights on hair
anime.camara_lente: cinematic anime camera framing, 35mm perspective, finely detailed expressive eyes with starry reflections, sharp clean lineart
anime.composicion_espacio_negativo: evocative emotive scene with expansive painted sky or room, ample clean negative space in upper quadrant for Japanese or Latin typography
anime.negative_prompts: western cartoon style, ugly distorted face, creepy eyes, 3D CGI plastic uncanny, low resolution, sketch lines, jpeg artifacts

digital.descripcion: Ilustración digital contemporánea para portadas, concept art y landings. Texturas de pincel ricas creadas en Procreate / Photoshop, paletas cromáticas cinematográficas y alto nivel de detalle.
digital.estilo_medio: contemporary digital illustration, ArtStation trending concept art, editorial digital painting, Procreate and Photoshop masterwork
digital.iluminacion: cinematic storytelling lighting, strong key light with subtle colored atmospheric fill, rich textural volume
digital.camara_lente: dynamic digital canvas composition, sharp focal point with artistic loose textured strokes in peripheral areas
digital.composicion_espacio_negativo: deliberately structured commercial layout, 40% clean atmospheric gradient negative space for title and branding
digital.negative_prompts: flat clipart, generic stock vector, amateur doodle, blurry low-res pixels, muddy colors, deformed anatomy

abstract.nombre: Abstract / Arte Abstracto Moderno & Formas Fluidas
abstract.descripcion: Composición abstracta contemporánea con formas fluidas, gradientes audaces, superposiciones translúcidas y geometría minimalista para fondos de marca y creatividad de alto nivel.
abstract.estilo_medio: modern abstract fine art, dynamic fluid shapes, layered minimalist geometry, contemporary museum exhibition piece
abstract.iluminacion: soft diffuse ambient illumination, gentle subsurface glowing gradients, subtle drop shadows separating layers
abstract.camara_lente: abstract flat perspective, edge-to-edge optical clarity, balanced spatial weight and organic rhythm
abstract.composicion_espacio_negativo: harmonious asymmetric tension, 50% open negative space for bold central typography and minimalist UI elements
abstract.negative_prompts: chaotic messy scribbles, figurative human shapes, photographic realism, dirty muddy color mixes, low resolution noise

comic_americano.nombre: Cómic Americano / Pop Art & Halftone Dots
comic_americano.descripcion: Estilo cómic clásico estadounidense y Pop Art estilo Roy Lichtenstein. Tramas de puntos Ben-Day, tintas de contorno negras gruesas, líneas de velocidad y colores primarios de alto impacto.
comic_americano.estilo_medio: vintage American comic book style, Pop Art Ben-Day dots halftone texture, dynamic graphic novel illustration
comic_americano.iluminacion: high contrast graphic lighting, bold black ink shadows, saturated solid color blocks, action-packed visual punch
comic_americano.camara_lente: dramatic dynamic comic book angle, heroic forced perspective, razor-sharp inking lines
comic_americano.composicion_espacio_negativo: bold character with action lines, framed by comic book panel borders with yellow/white caption box negative space for text
comic_americano.negative_prompts: soft photographic blur, 3D CGI plastic, muddy gray gradients, photorealism, dull washed-out tones

claymation.descripcion: Animación en plastilina y arcilla estilo Aardman (Wallace & Gromit). Textura táctil de plastilina con pequeñas huellas dactilares artesanales, ojos saltones simpáticos e iluminación de estudio en miniatura.
claymation.estilo_medio: authentic claymation stop-motion animation, handcrafted polymer clay sculpture, Aardman and Laika studio aesthetic
claymation.iluminacion: miniature studio tabletop lighting, warm soft key light with gentle specular reflections on clay surface
claymation.camara_lente: 50mm macro tilt-shift lens at f/4, shallow miniature depth of field, sharp focus on tactile clay thumbprint textures
claymation.composicion_espacio_negativo: charming handcrafted character on colorful miniature set, clean pastel backdrop for friendly commercial messages
claymation.negative_prompts: smooth digital CGI plastic, realistic human pores, vector drawing, flat paper, sharp polygon edges

editorial_producto_lujo.descripcion: Fotografía publicitaria de botellas, cosmética y productos premium. Iluminación de estudio en softbox doble y nitidez total de punta a punta.
editorial_producto_lujo.estilo_medio: high-end commercial product photography, luxury advertising campaign, Hasselblad medium format
editorial_producto_lujo.iluminacion: studio softbox at 45 degrees, balanced golden rim light, crisp specular highlights on glass edges, diffused fill light
editorial_producto_lujo.camara_lente: shot on 85mm lens at f/8 studio aperture, focus stacked, pin-sharp edge-to-edge clarity, hyperrealistic glass and liquid texture
editorial_producto_lujo.composicion_espacio_negativo: product placed in lower 60% of frame, resting solidly on wet dark slate surface with authentic physical contact shadows, upper 40% clean dark negative space
editorial_producto_lujo.negative_prompts: blurry subject, out of focus subject, extreme bokeh, plastic skin, distorted reflections, oversaturated neon, text watermark

gastronomia_gourmet.nombre: Gastronomía Artesanal / Café de Especialidad & Alimentos
gastronomia_gourmet.descripcion: Fotografía gastronómica y de café de especialidad. Texturas sensoriales, luz rasante lateral y vapor sutil.
gastronomia_gourmet.estilo_medio: high-end commercial food and beverage photography, luxury artisan culinary campaign
gastronomia_gourmet.iluminacion: dramatic studio lighting, soft directional gold rim light, balanced fill light, glistening condensation beads, rich amber liquid translucency
gastronomia_gourmet.camara_lente: Hasselblad medium format, crisp f/8 aperture, focus stacked, pin-sharp focus, tactile water droplets and food texture
gastronomia_gourmet.composicion_espacio_negativo: subject resting solidly on dark rustic textured wet slate with authentic contact shadows, top 35% completely clean dark negative space
gastronomia_gourmet.negative_prompts: blurry subject, extreme macro blur, creamy bokeh, flat sticker cut-out, artificial foam, messy table, watermark

splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.nombre: Fotografía de Bebidas de Acción / Splash de Alta Velocidad
splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.descripcion: Gotas y salpicaduras congeladas a 1/8000s alrededor del envase o bebida con máxima energía y nitidez.
splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.estilo_medio: high-speed commercial beverage photography, dynamic frozen liquid action, Red Bull / Corona commercial aesthetic
splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.iluminacion: multi-strobe flash photography at 1/8000s, backlit translucent liquid splash, dramatic edge illumination, sparkling ice crystal refractions
splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.camara_lente: 100mm macro lens at f/8, ultra-fast 1/8000s shutter speed, razor-sharp frozen water droplets, zero motion blur on product
splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.composicion_espacio_negativo: hero product anchored in dynamic lower center, explosive splash arching upwards, reserved lateral or upper 35% clean dark space
splash_liquido_alta_velocidad.negative_prompts: motion blur on bottle, muddy liquid, plastic drops, cartoon splash, distorted glass, blurry label

dark_tech_saas.descripcion: Estética técnica en fondo pizarra oscuro, acentos cian y violeta frío y acabados estilo Linear/Stripe.
dark_tech_saas.estilo_medio: minimalist dark UI commercial render, frosted glassmorphism 3D aesthetic, Linear app style
dark_tech_saas.iluminacion: subtle cyan and indigo edge lighting, soft volumetric glow, deep black shadows, raytraced reflections
dark_tech_saas.camara_lente: 35mm clean architectural framing, isometric low-angle perspective, pin-sharp geometry at f/8
dark_tech_saas.composicion_espacio_negativo: subject strictly in lower quadrant, generous 45% deep slate negative space for technical copy and metrics
dark_tech_saas.negative_prompts: cheap purple gradient, 90s clip-art, oversaturated cartoon, blurry edges, messy wires, cluttered noise
